_comment: Shared defaults for every PRODUCTION tenant loader. Individual tenants override these in tenants/prod/<slug>.json. Change a value here and it reaches every prod tenant on the next publish — no tenant deploy.
_apiComment: Prod tenants reach the tracking API through cdn.decentcare.ai, which forwards to omnilens.decentcare.ai. Unlike dev, prod /collect requires BOTH an x-tenant-id header and a Bearer token, so every prod tenant must declare a real tenantId and the distribution must inject the token as an origin custom header.
_fingerprintComment: Served from our own CDN rather than jsdelivr: this executes on every tenant's site, so a third party in that position is both an availability risk (blocked networks) and a supply-chain one. Stored as a PATH, not a URL — the generator prefixes the environment's CDN origin, so a prod loader can never be published pointing at the dev CDN. Pinned to an exact version, sha256 recorded in tenants/VENDOR.md.
_domMutationComment: virtualNumbers and whatsapp both rewrite content on a client's live page, and are on by default. A tenant whose hostname is unregistered or whose number pool is empty will call assign and get a 4xx/5xx on every page view; the tracker reports that as virtual_number_assign_failed rather than failing silently, and nothing on the page is altered. Set enabled:false per tenant to opt out.

virtualNumbers._phoneTextSelectorComment: Matched elements have their entire textContent replaced with the number, so only add selectors for elements that contain nothing but the phone number. A broad selector like .phone would wipe out any icon or label sitting beside it. Numbers inside tel: anchors are handled separately by telLinkSelector and do not need to be listed here.
